summary: Connect AI, cyber, model and resilience risks to enterprise decisions. Review the five-day course and its practical risk reporting outputs.
lede: AI-enabled enterprise risk management training helps risk leaders connect digital exposures with enterprise decisions. Chief risk officers, enterprise risk managers, AI governance leads and internal auditors practise building integrated risk registers, assessing AI use cases and rating scenarios, then defining indicators, control ownership and escalation priorities. Exercises also address model oversight, cyber and resilience risks, and preparing summaries for board discussions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who set risk direction, assess emerging exposures or oversee controls across AI-enabled operations and digital transformation.
modules: AI Risk Assessment with NIST AI RMF
Climate Risk and IFRS S2 Considerations
Integrated Risk Reporting and Board Decisions
prerequisites: Working familiarity with enterprise risk, audit, compliance, strategy or operational control processes is recommended. No coding or model-building experience is required.
